comparison.objective: Angle a rigid click-lock floor tile into a laid row, lower it flat, and release it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-edge alignment, angled tongue insertion, controlled lowering, and full-length lock engagement.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends are locked with seam, lippage, flatness, end-gap, pull-test, release, and rest requirements.
comparison.reason: Both require long-part alignment and retention, but flooring tests continuous tongue-and-groove engagement along one edge. The candidate tests handed articulated-rail installation at four discrete spring-loaded holes across two posts plus screw placement.
